title: The Oath of the Weeping Wood Revisited
author: Mara Amberdale
blurb: Ulyana Zhou, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
